Blocked + reflected. Spell Reflection triggers before Spell Block, so Doom returns while the original is blocked.
New roll. Chaos Bolt calculates fresh damage and stun values instead of copying the original roll.
Every cast is reflected. Echo Shell re-casts each Fireblast instance generated by Multicast.
Still reflects. Most targeted projectiles check Spell Reflection when they hit, not when cast.
On cast. Charge of Darkness reflects before impact, and its reflected cast does not Greater Bash.
None. Lotus only reflects manually cast Frostbite, not Frostbite applied by upgraded Freezing Field.
